title: Why the Harbour Glows
paras: In a short nature film, a quiet [[harbour|harbour]] turns blue at night. Each wave leaves a line of light beside the boats. The opening scene looks almost unreal, but the film explains a natural event: tiny living things in the water produce light when the water around them moves.

These flashes may help protect them from animals that eat them. A sudden light can surprise an attacker or attract a larger animal that might eat it. However, seeing this display can [[require|require]] patience. Bright lights along the nearby [[highway|highway]] make the blue flashes harder to notice, so the camera team waits for a dark night.

The team is [[prepared|prepared]] for a long wait, with warm clothes and food. They have [[written|written]] permission for [[entry|entry]] to a boat yard after dark. At first, their camera screen seems [[blank|blank]]. Then a wave breaks against a rope, and blue light appears. Several people spending their [[leisure|leisure]] time fishing stop to watch.

A magazine [[review|review]] praises the film for explaining the science without hiding the beauty. In a small audience [[survey|survey]], many viewers say they had thought the colour came from lamps under the water. The final scene shows a boat moving slowly away, leaving a blue path that disappears as the water becomes still.
zh: 在一部自然短片中，宁静的港湾在夜晚变成了蓝色。每一道波浪都在船边留下一条光带。开场画面看起来几乎不像真的，但影片解释的是一种自然现象：水中微小的生物会在周围的水流动时发光。
这些闪光可能有助于保护它们，使它们免遭其他动物捕食。突然出现的光可能吓到捕食者，也可能引来可能吃掉捕食者的更大动物。不过，想看到这番景象可能需要耐心。附近公路上的明亮灯光让蓝色闪光更难被发现，因此拍摄团队要等待一个漆黑的夜晚。
团队带着保暖衣物和食物，已经做好了长时间等待的准备。他们拿到了书面许可，可以在天黑后进入一处船场。起初，摄像机屏幕上似乎空无一物。随后，一道波浪拍上一根绳索，蓝光便出现了。几个利用闲暇时间钓鱼的人停下来观看。
一篇杂志影评称赞这部影片既解释了科学原理，又保留了自然之美。在一项小型观众调查中，许多观众表示，他们原以为这种颜色来自水下的灯。最后一个镜头中，一艘船缓缓驶离，留下一条蓝色的轨迹；随着水面恢复平静，这条轨迹也消失了。

q.s: Movement in the water causes the tiny organisms to give off light.
q.why: 首段说明周围的水流动时，微小生物会发光。

q.s: The lights beside the road help the team see the blue flashes more clearly.
q.why: 第二段说公路灯光使蓝色闪光更难被看见。

q.s: Most people who answered the audience survey were watching a nature film for the first time.
q.why: 文中未提调查对象以前是否看过自然影片。
